description: This PHP file defines the LessBinary class within the Twig templating engine. It implements a binary expression node for the '<' (less than) operator, including compilation logic for PHP versions below 8.0. The class extends AbstractBinary and contains methods for compiling the expression and providing the operator symbol.

classes.name: LessBinary
classes.description: A class representing the less-than ('<') binary operation in Twig's expression language, capable of compiling itself into PHP code.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the LessBinary node into PHP code, handling version-specific differences in compilation.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the operator ('<').
